ex.title: Hi, I'm Giulia.
ex.text: I started roasting after a trip to Italy showed me what fresh beans can do. Today I roast 5 kg at a time in a small workshop on the Oudegracht and ship the coffee while it is still young.
rev.title: What customers say
rev.sample: Sample reviews, written for this practice project.
rev.1: Canale Blend is now our daily coffee. Soft, round, and it arrived two days after I ordered.
rev.2: Domtoren makes a proper espresso with real crema. Even my Italian father-in-law approved.
rev.3: The Ethiopia tastes like peach tea, in the best way. I order a 1 kg bag every month now.
rev.4: I gave the Discovery set as a gift. Lovely box, and three coffees I would never have picked myself.
rev.5: Picked up my order at the workshop. Giulia explained the grind for my moka. Great service.
faq.title: Quick answers
faq.a1: Orders ship within 48 hours with PostNL, in the Netherlands. Shipping is €4.95, free over €40.
faq.a2: Whole beans stay freshest. No grinder? Choose moka, filter or espresso and we grind it just before packing.
faq.a3: We roast to order, the day before it ships. It tastes best in the first weeks after roasting.
faq.a4: Accessories can be returned within 14 days. Opened coffee cannot be returned, but write to us if something is wrong.
faq.q5: Can I pick up my order?
faq.a5: Yes, for free at the workshop, Tue–Sat 09:00–17:00. Choose pickup at checkout.

pdesc.canale-blend: Our everyday coffee. Soft, round, great for moka and filter. If you don't know where to start, start here.
pdesc.domtoren-espresso: Intense and creamy, made for people who like a bold espresso. Holds up well with milk too.

pdesc.guatemala-huehuetenango: Balanced and sweet, with a clean acidity. Good as filter and as espresso.
pdesc.decaf-colombia: All the taste, none of the caffeine. For the evening, or for anyone who avoids caffeine.

about.h1: A small roaster on the canal
about.p1: I'm Giulia, and I have been roasting coffee since a trip to Italy showed me what fresh beans can do.
about.p2: Since 2021 I have run a small 5 kg roaster on the Oudegracht in Utrecht. I pick each lot myself from small producers, roast it in small batches and ship it young.
about.p3: Everything we sell is something we drink ourselves. If you want advice on beans or grind, just ask.
about.alt: Giulia Ferri roasting coffee in the workshop
vals.title: What we care about
val1.d: 5 kg at a time, so every bag is roasted days, not months, before you open it.
val2.d: Every lot comes from a small producer we can name.
val3.d: Paper bags and cardboard boxes, no plastic filler.
val4.d: The price you see is the price you pay, and shipping is shown before you order.

legal.updated: Practice project. Last updated 11 November 2026. These texts are a starting point; a real shop needs them checked by a professional.
priv.s1.p: Tostino is an invented coffee roastery, made as a practice project by Antonio Frungillo. No real business, orders or payments exist.
priv.s2.p: This site keeps only your chosen language in your browser (localStorage). Your cart is kept by Snipcart, the shopping cart service we use, not by this site.
priv.s3.p: When you check out, Snipcart collects your name, email, delivery address and order, and passes the payment on to Mollie. We see the order in the Snipcart dashboard. In this practice project payments run in test mode and no goods are shipped. Do not enter real card details.
priv.s4.p: Snipcart (cart and checkout) and Mollie (payments such as iDEAL and cards) load scripts from their own servers and process your data under their own privacy policies. There are no analytics and no ads. Fonts are hosted on this site. The map and GitHub links open other sites only if you click them.
priv.s5.p: The contact form opens your own email app. We only receive a message if you send it. Questions: ciao@tostino.example.
priv.s6.h: If this becomes a real shop
priv.s6.p: A real shop needs a data-processing agreement with each provider, retention periods, a legal basis for each purpose and real company details. These texts are a starting point: have them checked by a professional before going live.
cook.s1.p: This website itself sets no cookies and has no analytics or ads. The cart and checkout run on Snipcart, and payments (such as iDEAL and cards) on Mollie. Scripts from their servers load on every page, and they may set cookies or use browser storage that is needed to keep your cart and process the payment. Their own cookie policies apply.
cook.s2.h: What is stored in your browser
cook.s2.l2: Snipcart: your cart and session data, set by Snipcart's own scripts.
cook.s2.l3: Mollie: payment processing, on Mollie's own payment pages.
cook.s2.p: The language choice is needed for the shop to work. We do not control what Snipcart and Mollie store; see their policies.
cook.s3.p: This practice version shows no banner. A real shop must check with a professional whether it needs consent for what the payment providers store, and add a banner if so.
terms.s1.p: Tostino is invented. Payments run in test mode and nothing will be shipped. The terms below describe how the shop would work.
terms.s2.p: We ship in the Netherlands with PostNL for €4.95. Orders over €40 ship free. Orders leave within 48 hours.
terms.s3.p: Free pickup at the workshop, Oudegracht 112 in Utrecht, Tue–Sat 09:00–17:00.
terms.s4.p: Accessories can be returned within 14 days in their original condition. Opened coffee cannot be returned. If something is wrong with your coffee, write to us and we will sort it out.
terms.s5.p: Prices are in euros and include VAT. Shipping is shown before you pay.
terms.s6.p: Payments are handled by Snipcart and Mollie, in test mode in this practice project. Which payment methods you see depends on how the payment provider is set up.
